changelog:
**Build for Jellyfin 12.**

- fix(discovery): keep detail-page discovery section after native lists when a theme sets flex order
 - fix(maintainerr): pick the collection by the version selected on the item page
 - feat(maintainerr): mark, keep and postpone seasons from the item menu
 - chore(ci)(deps): bump trufflesecurity/trufflehog from 3.99.8 to 3.99.9 in the github-actions group ([#1073](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1073))
 - fix(tags): keep the version picker on the remembered pick when the item page refreshes it
 - feat(reclaimerr): Reclaimerr as a removal tool beside Maintainerr, with a Leaving Soon page ([#1075](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1075))
 - feat(seerr): show the series' Similar and Recommended rows on season and episode pages ([#1074](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1074))
 - fix(bookmarks): clear the seek-bar marker when the last bookmark is deleted ([#1072](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1072))
 - Translations update from Hosted Weblate ([#1077](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1077))
 - Translations update from Hosted Weblate ([#1078](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1078))
 - fix(elsewhere): explain, check and allow uploading the custom branding icon ([#1080](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1080))
 - fix(config): keep the MDBList ratings list in step on the Services tab and style it like the other groups
 - fix(mdblist): drop the AniList rating source, honour 429 Retry-After and rate-limit headers
 - feat(leaving-soon): serve the leaving titles as an item list for KefinTweaks
 - feat(leaving-soon): hide watched titles in the home row
 - chore(tests): regenerate production inventory
 - fix(seerr): keep the region in the search language so TMDB returns the right regional titles ([#1082](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1082))
 - fix(tests): update api.md route total and config flag groups for leaving soon
 - feat(admin): analytics icon on reported settings and tab/card in the config page address
 - chore(tests): regenerate production inventory
 - fix(seerr): let the discovery section span the full width on themes that grid .detailSection
 - fix(admin): keep Media Tags deep links when the address follows the open tab, update api.md route total and in-place link test
 - feat(seerr): filters on Recommendations, filters in the page address, all or any, Without genres and language, saved filters ([#1084](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1084))
 - fix(seerr): Filters pill and Series tab under Jellyfish, Zesty and JellyFlix themes ([#1085](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1085))
 - perf(tags): write the quality chip base CSS once instead of once per quality colour (374 KB to 26 KB)
 - docs: Open in Jellyfin page, docs restructure, and move the build to Zensical ([#1086](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1086))
 - feat(reclaimerr): create Reclaimerr accounts for Jellyfin users and show a person's own removal requests
 - chore(tests): regenerate production inventory
 - fix(activity): show season and episode for episodes in Active Streams
 - docs(api): document reclaimerr/create-users and bump the route total to 224
 - feat(leaving-soon): request-style cards, sizes, and sturdier Reclaimerr request handling ([#1089](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1089))
 - perf: lighter Home screen with lazy feature bundles and cheaper tags ([#1088](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1088))
 - fix(admintags): Media Tags confirmations no longer rebuild the configuration page ([#1090](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1090))
 - feat(reclaimerr): approve a deletion request for later, with Reclaimerr's grace period, now, or a chosen day
 - feat(reclaimerr): use Reclaimerr 0.6.15's token API, add a user audit, drop the service account ([#1091](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1091))
 - fix(admin): analytics icons reapply on refresh, hide sidebar links for hidden groups, search-mode card gaps, wrap New badge on small widths
 - fix(leavingsoon): drop Cancel and Reset timer from the removal date dialog, remove unused locale key
 - fix(i18n): add the 72 missing leavingsoon and discovery filter strings to every locale
 - chore(i18n): drop four obsolete discovery filter keys from every locale (Weblate sync)
 - test(leavingsoon): the removal date dialog no longer has Reset timer or Cancel
 - test(admin): wait for the search debounce instead of a fixed 250 ms
 - fix(reclaimerr): drop a redundant string cast flagged by CodeQL
 - Translations update from Hosted Weblate ([#1093](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/1093))
 - fix(reclaimerr): drop a redundant string cast flagged by CodeQL
name: Jellyfin Enhanced
overview: Jellyfin Enhanced and Jellyfin Elsewhere for a better Jellyfin experience.
